chunks: Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn Ali ibn al-Husayn ibn Musa ibn Babawayh al-Qummi (may Allah have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: 'Abd al-Rahman ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid narrated to us. He said: Muhammad ibn Durustawayh al-Farisi narrated to us. He said: 'Abd al-Rahman ibn Muhammad ibn Mansur narrated to us. He said: Abu Dawud al-Tayalisi narrated to us. He said: Shu'ba narrated to us. He said: Hammad ibn Abi Sulayman narrated to me from Anas. He said: I heard the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) saying:

Whoever fasts one day from Rajab out of faith and anticipation, Allah -- blessed and exalted be He -- will place between him and the Fire seventy trenches, the width of each trench being the distance between heaven and earth.

key_terms.إِيمَاناً وَاحْتِسَاباً: Out of faith and anticipation: sincere motivation, not merely ritual compliance
key_terms.سَبْعِينَ خَنْدَقاً: Seventy trenches: a metaphor for the vast protective barrier Allah places between the fasting person and the Fire

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for fasting one day in Rajab according to the Prophet Muhammad in al-Amali of Sheikh al-Saduq?
ai.summary: The Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) declared the immense reward for fasting even a single day in the month of Rajab -- that Allah will place seventy trenches between the faster and Hellfire, each trench as wide as the distance between heaven and earth. This was narrated in the third assembly of Sheikh al-Saduq's Amali through a chain from Anas, a companion of the Prophet.

en.bilal-muhammad: Abu Ja`far Muhammad b. `Ali b. al-Husayn b. Musa b. Babuwayh al-Qummi (rh) narrated to us. He said: `Abd al-Rahman b. Muhammad b. Khalid narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. Darsatuwayh al-Farisi narrated to us. He said: `Abd al-Rahman b. Muhammad b. Mansur narrated to us. He said: Abu Dawud al-Tayalisi narrated to us. He said: Shu`ba narrated to us. He said: Hamad b. Abi Sulayman narrated to me from Anas.  He said: I heard the Prophet (s) said:
Whoever fasts one day from Rajab out of faith and anticipation, Allah will put seventy trenches between him and the Fire. The width of each trench would be the distance between heaven and Earth.
